sources.army_rules: BSData/wh40k-11e Orks catalogue: Waaagh! and War Cry.

back.title: INTIMIDATING MOTIVATION
paragraphs: WARBOSS or NAZDREG, once per battle round, per army (shared by both): in your Movement phase, at the start or end of its move, one friendly ORKS unit within 6" is no longer battle-shocked and is riled up.
Remove at the start of your next turn.

back.title: GET BACK IN DA RACE!
paragraphs: WARTRIKE, once per battle round, per army: in your Movement phase, at the start or end of its move, one friendly SPEED FREEKS unit within 6" (and any units embarked in it) is no longer battle-shocked and is riled up.
Remove at the start of your next turn.

back.title: FLYBOSS
paragraphs: FLYBOSS (an ORKS AIRCRAFT enhancement): when it ends an ingress move, each friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit within 6" is riled up.
Remove at the start of your next turn.

back.title: WAR CRY
paragraphs: Once per battle, per army. At the start of the Command phase: friendly ORKS units with the Waaagh! ability are riled up until the end of the next turn.
Remove this token when used.

back.title: CHARGE BONUSES
paragraphs: WARBIKERS: High-speed Carnage. Melee attacks have +1 S and D.
WARBOSS: Might is Right. Melee attacks have +3 A and +2 S.
Remove at the end of the turn.

back.title: ADRENALINE JUNKIES
paragraphs: After a SPEED FREEKS unit makes an advance/fall-back move: its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT], and that move does not prevent it being eligible to declare a charge.
Remove at the end of the turn.

back.title: ADRENALINE JUNKIES
paragraphs: After a SPEED FREEKS unit makes an advance/fall-back move: its ranged attacks have [ASSAULT], and that move does not prevent it being eligible to declare a charge.
Remove at the end of the turn.

back.title: SPEEDIEST FREEKS
paragraphs: Ranged attacks that target this SPEED FREEKS unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.
Remove at the end of the phase.

tokens.source: Kult of Speed stratagem. Lasting the whole phase is the user's ruling.

back.title: GRAB IT
paragraphs: This unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
Remove at the end of the turn.

back.title: HULKING BRUTES
paragraphs: 1CP: ranged attacks that target this unit with a S greater than its T have -1 to wound rolls.
2CP: ranged attacks that target this unit have -1 to wound rolls.

tokens.source: Bully Boyz stratagem. The card states no duration.

back.title: TOO ARROGANT TO DIE
paragraphs: When a model in this unit is destroyed, if it has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6 (+1 if riled up). On a 4+, leave the model on the battlefield until the unit has fought or the end of the phase. Mark it with a Not Dead Yet marker.

tokens.source: Bully Boyz stratagem. The card states no duration.

back.title: NOT DEAD YET
paragraphs: Remove the model when its unit has fought, or at the end of the phase.

back.title: BUST 'EM
paragraphs: WARTRAKKS: after shooting, one enemy unit hit is busted. Friendly SPEED FREEKS units' attacks that target it have [LETHAL HITS].
Remove at the end of the turn.

back.title: SQUIG BARRAGE
paragraphs: RUKKATRUKK: after shooting, one enemy unit (not MONSTER/VEHICLE) hit by Squig Launchas is covered in Squigs. Its attacks have -1 to hit rolls.
Remove at the start of your next turn.

back.title: DEFF FROM ABOVE
paragraphs: DEFFKOPTAS: in your Shooting phase, if this unit made an ingress move this turn, its ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.
Remove at the end of the turn.

back.title: THIEVIN' SCAVENGERS
paragraphs: GRETCHIN: at the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.

back.title: AMMO RUNTS
paragraphs: NOBZ, once per battle: when selected to shoot, this unit's ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.
Remove this token when used.

back.title: BOSS' AMMO RUNT
paragraphs: WARBOSS, once per battle: when selected to shoot, this model's ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.
Remove this token when used.

back.title: BOMB SQUIG
paragraphs: TANKBUSTAS, once per turn, twice per battle: when this unit ends a normal move, roll one D6 against a visible enemy unit within 12". On a 3+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.
Remove one token each time it is used.

back.title: PULSA ROKKIT
paragraphs: TANKBUSTAS, once per battle: when selected to shoot, pick an enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit within 24". Attacks that target it have +1 AP and [LETHAL HITS].
Remove this token when used.

back.title: CATCH DAT RED BIT
paragraphs: PAINBOY, once per battle: when it uses Crude Surgery, add D3 to the number of wounds it heals.
Remove this token when used.
